def verify(self) -> None:
        version = self._session.scalar(
            select(ProjectVersionRecord)
            .where(
                ProjectVersionRecord.id == self._snapshot_id,
                ProjectVersionRecord.project_id == self._project_id,
            )
            .with_for_update(read=True)
        )
        if version is None or version.active_processing_run_id != self._authority.id:
            raise EmbeddingConflictError("Search evidence changed.")
        processing = self._session.scalar(
            select(ProcessingRunRecord).where(
                ProcessingRunRecord.id == self._authority.id,
                ProcessingRunRecord.project_version_id == self._snapshot_id,
            )
        )
        if (
            processing is None
            or processing.quarantined
            or processing.superseded
            or processing.revision != self._authority.revision
            or processing.processing_contract != self._authority.processing_contract
        ):
            raise EmbeddingConflictError("Search processing authority changed.")
        dependencies = list(
            self._session.execute(
                select(
                    ArtifactProcessingRecord.artifact_id,
                    ArtifactProcessingRecord.dependency_fingerprint,
                ).where(
                    ArtifactProcessingRecord.processing_run_id == self._authority.id,
                    ArtifactProcessingRecord.dependency_fingerprint.is_not(None),
                )
            )
        )
        if processing_freshness(
            self._authority,
            cast(list[tuple[UUID, str]], dependencies),
            structural_artifacts_in_session(self._session, version.active_analysis_id),
        ):
            raise EmbeddingConflictError("Search processing evidence is stale.")
        if self._embedding_run is not None:
            run = self._embedding_run
            selected = self._session.get(EmbeddingRunRecord, run.id)
            if (
                version.active_embedding_run_id != run.id
                or selected is None
                or selected.outcome != "complete"
                or selected.superseded
                or selected.quarantined
                or selected.project_id != self._project_id
                or selected.project_version_id != self._snapshot_id
                or selected.processing_run_id != self._authority.id
                or selected.processing_revision != self._authority.revision
                or selected.processing_contract != self._authority.processing_contract
                or selected.contract_digest != run.contract.digest
                or selected.dimensions != run.contract.dimensions
            ):
                raise EmbeddingConflictError("Search embedding authority changed.")

semantic-03.e1.label: ContextService.repack
semantic-03.e1.excerpt:
async def repack(
        self,
        result: ContextResult,
        fits: Callable[[tuple[ContextEvidenceItem, ...]], Awaitable[bool]],
    ) -> tuple[tuple[ContextEvidenceItem, ...], tuple[ContextDecision, ...]]:
        """Pack only existing whole evidence items, preserving seed support and order."""
        selected: list[ContextEvidenceItem] = []
        decisions: list[ContextDecision] = []
        surviving_seeds: set[UUID] = set()
        for item in result.items:
            chunk = item.chunk
            if not item.selected_as_seed and not _supported_parents(
                item.expanded_from, surviving_seeds
            ):
                reason = "parent_not_included"
            elif await fits((*selected, item)):
                selected.append(item)
                if item.selected_as_seed:
                    surviving_seeds.add(chunk.id)
                continue
            else:
                reason = "generation_budget"
            decisions.append(
                ContextDecision(
                    chunk.id,
                    chunk.stable_key,
                    str(chunk.locator),
                    "generation_packing",
                    "excluded",
                    reason,
                    item.expanded_from,
                    item.retrieval.rank if item.retrieval else None,
                    item.rerank_rank,
                    item.rerank_score,
                )
            )
        return tuple(selected), tuple(decisions)

async def ask(
    project_id: UUID,
    snapshot_id: UUID,
    body: AskRequestBody,
    response: Response,
    service: AskService = Depends(get_ask_service),
) -> AskResponse:
    response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-store"
    selected = body.filters
    request = AskRequest(
        project_id,
        snapshot_id,
        body.question,
        body.retrieval_mode,
        body.ranking_policy,
        RetrievalFilters(
            selected.locator_prefix if selected else None,
            selected.language if selected else None,
            selected.kind if selected else None,
        ),
    )
    return ask_response(await service.ask(request))

async def ask(self, request: AskRequest) -> GroundedAskResult:
        started = time.monotonic()
        deadline = started + self._policy.ask_timeout_seconds
        if not self.status()["configured"]:
            raise GenerationNotConfiguredError
        if not request.question.strip() or len(request.question.encode()) > 4096:
            raise AskInputError
        try:
            screen_content(request.question)
        except ContentRejectedError as error:
            raise AskInputError from error
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout_at(min(deadline, started + 120)):
                context = await asyncio.to_thread(
                    self._context.build,
                    request.project_id,
                    request.snapshot_id,
                    request.question,
                    request.retrieval_mode,
                    request.ranking_policy,
                    request.filters,
                )
        except TimeoutError as error:
            raise AskTimeoutError from error
        emit("ask_context", context)
        context_seconds = time.monotonic() - started
        original = tuple((f"E{index}", item) for index, item in enumerate(context.items, 1))
        original_digest = _digest(
            {
                "authority": str(context.processing_run.id),
                "embedding_authority": str(context.embedding_run.id)
                if context.embedding_run
                else None,
                "question": request.question,
                "retrieval": asdict(context.retrieval),
                "ranking_policy": context.ranking_policy,
                "evidence": [_item_projection(k, v) for k, v in original],
            }
        )
        request_id = uuid4()
        model = self._provider.contract
        if not original:
            return GroundedAskResult(
                request_id,
                "insufficient_evidence",
                "no_usable_evidence",
                "No usable evidence was found for this question.",
                (),
                (),
                (),
                context,
                (),
                self._policy,
                model,
                None,
                "skipped_no_evidence",
                original_digest,
                original_digest,
                None,
                None,
                None,
                None,
                None,
                context_seconds,
                0,
                0,
                time.monotonic() - started,
            )
        await self._verify(context, context.items, deadline)
        counting_started = time.monotonic()
        count_deadline = min(deadline, counting_started + self._policy.counting_timeout_seconds)
        fixed = await self._count(GroundedPrompt(PROMPT_VERSION, "", ()), count_deadline)
        base = await self._count(
            GroundedPrompt(PROMPT_VERSION, request.question, ()), count_deadline
        )
        if base.input_tokens > self._policy.input_limit:
            raise AskBudgetExceededError
        selected = original
        full_prompt = GroundedPrompt(PROMPT_VERSION, request.question, selected)
        measured = await self._count(full_prompt, count_deadline)
        decisions: tuple[ContextDecision, ...] = ()
        if measured.input_tokens > self._policy.input_limit:
            by_id = {item.chunk.id: key for key, item in original}
            accepted_measurement = base

            async def fits(items: tuple[ContextEvidenceItem, ...]) -> bool:
                nonlocal accepted_measurement
                proposed = GroundedPrompt(
                    PROMPT_VERSION,
                    request.question,
                    tuple((by_id[item.chunk.id], item) for item in items),
                )
                proposed_measurement = await self._count(proposed, count_deadline)
                accepted = proposed_measurement.input_tokens <= self._policy.input_limit
                if accepted:
                    accepted_measurement = proposed_measurement
                return accepted

            packed, decisions = await self._context.repack(context, fits)
            if not packed:
                raise AskBudgetExceededError
            selected = tuple((by_id[item.chunk.id], item) for item in packed)
            full_prompt = GroundedPrompt(PROMPT_VERSION, request.question, selected)
            measured = accepted_measurement
        if measured.input_tokens > self._policy.input_limit or (
            measured.input_tokens + self._policy.max_output_tokens > self._policy.context_limit
        ):
            raise AskBudgetExceededError
        counting_seconds = time.monotonic() - counting_started
        await self._verify(context, tuple(item for _, item in selected), deadline)
        emit("generation_evidence", full_prompt)
        emit("prompt_measurement", measured)
        emit("generation_decisions", decisions)
        generation_started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout_at(
                min(deadline, generation_started + self._policy.generation_timeout_seconds)
            ):
                generated = await self._provider.generate(
                    full_prompt,
                    self._policy,
                    min(deadline, generation_started + self._policy.generation_timeout_seconds),
                )
        except TimeoutError as error:
            raise AskTimeoutError from error
        generation_seconds = time.monotonic() - generation_started
        capture(
            "generation_response_metadata",
            lambda: {
                "state": generated.state,
                "returned_model": generated.returned_model,
                "input_tokens": generated.input_tokens,
                "output_tokens": generated.output_tokens,
                "generation_seconds": generation_seconds,
            },
        )
        if generated.state == "refused":
            raise GenerationRefusedError
        if generated.state != "completed":
            raise GenerationOutputInvalidError
        if any(
            value is not None and (type(value) is not int or value < 0)
            for value in (generated.input_tokens, generated.output_tokens)
        ):
            raise GenerationOutputInvalidError
        try:
            status, statements = validate_output(
                generated.raw_text, tuple(key for key, _ in selected)
            )
        except CitationInvalidError as error:
            raise GenerationCitationInvalidError from error
        except OutputInvalidError as error:
            raise GenerationOutputInvalidError from error
        evidence = tuple(ResolvedCitation(key, item) for key, item in selected)
        evidence_map = {citation.evidence_id: citation for citation in evidence}
        used = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(key for statement in statements for key in statement.evidence_ids)
        )
        citations = tuple(evidence_map[key] for key in used)
        answer_text = (
            "\n".join(
                ("Inference: " if statement.support == "inference" else "") + statement.text
                for statement in statements
            )
            if statements
            else "The supplied evidence does not support an answer."
        )
        capture(
            "validated_answer",
            lambda: {
                "status": status,
                "answer_text": answer_text,
                "statements": statements,
                "citations": citations,
            },
        )
        await self._verify(context, tuple(item for _, item in selected), deadline)
        final_digest = _digest(
            {
                "authority": str(context.processing_run.id),
                "embedding_authority": str(context.embedding_run.id)
                if context.embedding_run
                else None,
                "question": request.question,
                "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
                "evidence": [_item_projection(k, v) for k, v in selected],
            }
        )
        return GroundedAskResult(
            request_id,
            "answered" if status == "answered" else "insufficient_evidence",
            "evidence_does_not_support_answer" if status == "insufficient_evidence" else None,
            answer_text,
            statements,
            citations,
            evidence,
            context,
            decisions,
            self._policy,
            model,
            generated.returned_model,
            "completed",
            original_digest,
            final_digest,
            fixed.input_tokens,
            base.input_tokens,
            measured,
            generated.input_tokens,
            generated.output_tokens,
            context_seconds,
            counting_seconds,
            generation_seconds,
            time.monotonic() - started,
        )

def build(
        self,
        project_id: UUID,
        snapshot_id: UUID,
        query: str,
        retrieval_mode: RetrievalMode,
        ranking_policy: RankingPolicy,
        filters: RetrievalFilters | None = None,
    ) -> ContextResult:
        if ranking_policy not in {"local_cross_encoder", "retrieval_order"}:
            raise ContextInputError("Ranking policy is invalid.")
        if self._sizer.measure(query, []) > self._byte_limit:
            raise ContextInputError("Query cannot fit the context evidence allowance.")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + self._request_timeout
        selected_filters = filters or RetrievalFilters()
        try:
            retrieved = self._retrieval.context_candidates(
                project_id,
                snapshot_id,
                retrieval_mode,
                query,
                selected_filters,
            )
        except EmbeddingConflictError as error:
            raise ContextConflictError("Retrieval evidence changed.") from error
        emit("retrieval", retrieved)
        self._check_deadline(deadline)
        decisions: list[ContextDecision] = []
        candidates = self._deduplicate_and_validate(retrieved.hits, decisions)
        self._check_source_bound(item.hit.chunk for item in candidates)

        eligible: list[_RankedCandidate] = []
        for candidate in candidates:
            if self._sizer.measure(query, [candidate.hit.chunk]) > self._byte_limit:
                decisions.append(
                    self._decision(candidate, "filter", "excluded", "item_exceeds_budget")
                )
            else:
                eligible.append(candidate)

        reranker_state: RerankerState
        if ranking_policy == "retrieval_order":
            reranker_state = "not_requested"
            ranked = eligible
        elif not eligible:
            reranker_state = "not_needed"
            ranked = []
        else:
            reranker_state = "completed"
            ranked = self._rerank(query, eligible, deadline, decisions)

        observation = capture(
            "ranking",
            lambda: self._observe_ranking(retrieved.hits, eligible, ranked, decisions),
        )
        seeds = ranked[:SEED_COUNT]
        for candidate in ranked[SEED_COUNT:]:
            decisions.append(
                self._decision(candidate, "seed_selection", "excluded", "outside_seed_count")
            )

        neighbours, parent_edges = self._expand(
            project_id,
            snapshot_id,
            retrieved.processing_run,
            retrieved.embedding_run,
            seeds,
            selected_filters,
            deadline,
        )
        self._check_source_bound(
            [candidate.hit.chunk for candidate in candidates] + list(neighbours)
        )

        packed: list[_Draft] = []
        included_ids: set[UUID] = set()
        for candidate in seeds:
            draft = _Draft(candidate.hit.chunk, candidate, True)
            if self._try_pack(query, packed, draft):
                included_ids.add(draft.chunk.id)
                decisions.append(self._decision(candidate, "packing", "included", "included_seed"))
            else:
                reason = (
                    "item_count_limit" if len(packed) >= self._item_limit else "remaining_budget"
                )
                decisions.append(self._decision(candidate, "packing", "excluded", reason))

        direct = {candidate.hit.chunk.id: candidate for candidate in candidates}
        neighbour_order = sorted(
            neighbours,
            key=lambda chunk: (
                min(
                    (self._seed_rank(parent, seeds) for parent in parent_edges[chunk.id]),
                    default=SEED_COUNT + 1,
                ),
                chunk.part_index,
                chunk.stable_key,
                str(chunk.id),
            ),
        )[:EXPANDED_OBSERVATION_LIMIT]
        packed_by_id = {item.chunk.id: item for item in packed}
        for chunk in neighbour_order:
            parents = parent_edges[chunk.id]
            supported = _supported_parents(parents, included_ids)
            direct_candidate = direct.get(chunk.id)
            if not supported:
                decisions.append(
                    self._chunk_decision(
                        chunk,
                        direct_candidate,
                        "expansion",
                        "excluded",
                        "parent_not_included",
                        parents,
                    )
                )
                continue
            existing = packed_by_id.get(chunk.id)
            if existing:
                existing.parents.update(supported)
                continue
            draft = _Draft(chunk, direct_candidate, False, set(supported))
            if self._sizer.measure(query, [chunk]) > self._byte_limit:
                reason = "item_exceeds_budget"
            elif self._try_pack(query, packed, draft):
                included_ids.add(chunk.id)
                packed_by_id[chunk.id] = draft
                decisions.append(
                    self._chunk_decision(
                        chunk,
                        direct_candidate,
                        "packing",
                        "included",
                        "included_neighbour",
                        supported,
                    )
                )
                continue
            else:
                reason = (
                    "item_count_limit" if len(packed) >= self._item_limit else "remaining_budget"
                )
            decisions.append(
                self._chunk_decision(
                    chunk, direct_candidate, "packing", "excluded", reason, supported
                )
            )

        self._final_verify(
            project_id,
            snapshot_id,
            retrieved.processing_run,
            retrieved.embedding_run,
            packed,
            deadline,
        )
        chunks = [item.chunk for item in packed]
        budget = self._sizer.budget(query, chunks, self._byte_limit)
        costs = dict(budget.per_item_costs)
        items = tuple(self._evidence(item, costs[item.chunk.id]) for item in packed)
        summary = ContextRetrievalSummary(
            retrieved.requested_mode,
            retrieved.executed_mode,
            retrieved.returned_count,
            100,
            retrieved.final_candidate_cap_truncated
            or retrieved.exact.truncated
            or retrieved.lexical.truncated
            or retrieved.semantic.truncated,
            retrieved.exact.candidate_count,
            retrieved.lexical.candidate_count,
            retrieved.semantic.candidate_count,
        )
        result = ContextResult(
            project_id,
            snapshot_id,
            query,
            ranking_policy,
            ContextPolicy(
                byte_limit=self._byte_limit,
                item_limit=self._item_limit,
                request_deadline_seconds=self._request_timeout,
                rerank_deadline_seconds=self._rerank_timeout,
                hydrated_source_byte_limit=self._source_byte_limit,
                response_byte_limit=self._response_byte_limit,
            ),
            retrieved.processing_run,
            retrieved.embedding_run,
            summary,
            reranker_state,
            self._runtime.provider.contract if reranker_state == "completed" else None,
            items,
            tuple(decisions),
            budget,
        )
        if len(self._diagnostic_projection(result)) > self._response_byte_limit:
            raise ContextLimitError("Context response exceeds its serialized-size limit.")
        result = replace(result, ranking_observation=observation)
        emit("context", result)
        return result

        if generated.state == "refused":
            raise GenerationRefusedError
        if generated.state != "completed":
            raise GenerationOutputInvalidError
        if any(
            value is not None and (type(value) is not int or value < 0)
            for value in (generated.input_tokens, generated.output_tokens)
        ):
            raise GenerationOutputInvalidError
        try:
            status, statements = validate_output(
                generated.raw_text, tuple(key for key, _ in selected)
            )
        except CitationInvalidError as error:
            raise GenerationCitationInvalidError from error
        except OutputInvalidError as error:
            raise GenerationOutputInvalidError from error
        evidence = tuple(ResolvedCitation(key, item) for key, item in selected)
        evidence_map = {citation.evidence_id: citation for citation in evidence}
        used = tuple(
            dict.fromkeys(key for statement in statements for key in statement.evidence_ids)
        )
        citations = tuple(evidence_map[key] for key in used)
        answer_text = (
            "\n".join(
                ("Inference: " if statement.support == "inference" else "") + statement.text
                for statement in statements
            )
            if statements
            else "The supplied evidence does not support an answer."
        )
        capture(
            "validated_answer",
            lambda: {
                "status": status,
                "answer_text": answer_text,
                "statements": statements,
                "citations": citations,
            },
        )
        await self._verify(context, tuple(item for _, item in selected), deadline)
        final_digest = _digest(
            {
                "authority": str(context.processing_run.id),
                "embedding_authority": str(context.embedding_run.id)
                if context.embedding_run
                else None,
                "question": request.question,
                "prompt_version": PROMPT_VERSION,
                "evidence": [_item_projection(k, v) for k, v in selected],
            }
        )
        return GroundedAskResult(
            request_id,
            "answered" if status == "answered" else "insufficient_evidence",
            "evidence_does_not_support_answer" if status == "insufficient_evidence" else None,
            answer_text,
            statements,
            citations,
            evidence,
            context,
            decisions,
            self._policy,
            model,
            generated.returned_model,
            "completed",
            original_digest,
            final_digest,
            fixed.input_tokens,
            base.input_tokens,
            measured,
            generated.input_tokens,
            generated.output_tokens,
            context_seconds,
            counting_seconds,
            generation_seconds,
            time.monotonic() - started,
        )

cross_file-04.e2.excerpt:
async def repack(
        self,
        result: ContextResult,
        fits: Callable[[tuple[ContextEvidenceItem, ...]], Awaitable[bool]],
    ) -> tuple[tuple[ContextEvidenceItem, ...], tuple[ContextDecision, ...]]:
        """Pack only existing whole evidence items, preserving seed support and order."""
        selected: list[ContextEvidenceItem] = []
        decisions: list[ContextDecision] = []
        surviving_seeds: set[UUID] = set()
        for item in result.items:
            chunk = item.chunk
            if not item.selected_as_seed and not _supported_parents(
                item.expanded_from, surviving_seeds
            ):
                reason = "parent_not_included"
            elif await fits((*selected, item)):
                selected.append(item)
                if item.selected_as_seed:
                    surviving_seeds.add(chunk.id)
                continue
            else:
                reason = "generation_budget"
            decisions.append(
                ContextDecision(
                    chunk.id,
                    chunk.stable_key,
                    str(chunk.locator),
                    "generation_packing",
                    "excluded",
                    reason,
                    item.expanded_from,
                    item.retrieval.rank if item.retrieval else None,
                    item.rerank_rank,
                    item.rerank_score,
                )
            )
        return tuple(selected), tuple(decisions)

async def generate(
        self, prompt: GroundedPrompt, policy: GenerationPolicy, deadline: float
    ) -> GenerationResponse:
        prepared = _prepared(prompt)
        if (
            policy.model_id != MODEL_ID
            or policy.context_limit != 1_048_576
            or policy.temperature is not None
            or policy.reasoning_effort is not None
            or policy.thinking_level != "medium"
            or policy.provider_store
            or policy.automatic_retries
            or policy.streaming
            or policy.tools_enabled
        ):
            raise GenerationConfigurationInvalidError
        from google.genai import types

        client = self._get_client()
        config_arguments = {
            "response_mime_type": prepared["response_mime_type"],
            "response_json_schema": prepared["response_json_schema"],
            "max_output_tokens": policy.max_output_tokens,
            "automatic_function_calling": types.AutomaticFunctionCallingConfig(disable=True),
        }
        config = types.GenerateContentConfig(**config_arguments)
        generation_settings(
            policy,
            {
                "model_id": prepared["model"],
                "max_output_tokens": config_arguments["max_output_tokens"],
            },
        )
        try:
            result = await client.aio.models.generate_content(
                model=prepared["model"],
                contents=prepared["contents"],
                config=config,
            )
        except Exception as error:
            self._translate(error, counting=False)
            raise AssertionError("unreachable") from error
        provider_reported_settings(result, "gemini.generation_response")
        candidates = getattr(result, "candidates", None) or ()
        candidate = next(iter(candidates), None) if len(candidates) == 1 else None
        finish = getattr(candidate, "finish_reason", None)
        finish_name = getattr(finish, "name", str(finish))
        if finish_name == "STOP":
            state: Literal["completed", "incomplete", "refused"] = "completed"
        elif finish_name in {"SAFETY", "BLOCKLIST", "PROHIBITED_CONTENT", "SPII", "RECITATION"}:
            state = "refused"
        else:
            state = "incomplete"
        parts = getattr(getattr(candidate, "content", None), "parts", None) or ()
        raw_text = "".join(
            part.text for part in parts if isinstance(getattr(part, "text", None), str)
        )
        usage = getattr(result, "usage_metadata", None)
        candidate_tokens = getattr(usage, "candidates_token_count", None) if usage else None
        thought_tokens = getattr(usage, "thoughts_token_count", None) if usage else None
        output_tokens = (
            candidate_tokens + (thought_tokens or 0)
            if type(candidate_tokens) is int and type(thought_tokens) in (int, type(None))
            else None
        )
        return GenerationResponse(
            raw_text,
            state,
            getattr(result, "model_version", None),
            getattr(usage, "prompt_token_count", None) if usage else None,
            output_tokens,
        )

async def lifespan(app: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
        runtime = LocalRuntime(active_settings)
        for name, value in vars(runtime).items():

        try:
            yield
        finally:
            await runtime.close()

async def close(self) -> None:
        # Release every owner even when one cleanup fails.
        try:
            self.embedding_runtime.close()
        finally:
            try:
                self.reranker_runtime.close()
            finally:
                try:
                    await self.generation_provider.close()
                finally:
                    self.engine.dispose()

def verify(self) -> None:
        version = self._session.scalar(
            select(ProjectVersionRecord)
            .where(
                ProjectVersionRecord.id == self._snapshot_id,
                ProjectVersionRecord.project_id == self._project_id,
            )
            .with_for_update(read=True)
        )
        if version is None or version.active_processing_run_id != self._authority.id:
            raise EmbeddingConflictError("Search evidence changed.")
        processing = self._session.scalar(
            select(ProcessingRunRecord).where(
                ProcessingRunRecord.id == self._authority.id,
                ProcessingRunRecord.project_version_id == self._snapshot_id,
            )
        )
        if (
            processing is None
            or processing.quarantined
            or processing.superseded
            or processing.revision != self._authority.revision
            or processing.processing_contract != self._authority.processing_contract
        ):
            raise EmbeddingConflictError("Search processing authority changed.")
        dependencies = list(
            self._session.execute(
                select(
                    ArtifactProcessingRecord.artifact_id,
                    ArtifactProcessingRecord.dependency_fingerprint,
                ).where(
                    ArtifactProcessingRecord.processing_run_id == self._authority.id,
                    ArtifactProcessingRecord.dependency_fingerprint.is_not(None),
                )
            )
        )
        if processing_freshness(
            self._authority,
            cast(list[tuple[UUID, str]], dependencies),
            structural_artifacts_in_session(self._session, version.active_analysis_id),
        ):
            raise EmbeddingConflictError("Search processing evidence is stale.")
        if self._embedding_run is not None:
            run = self._embedding_run
            selected = self._session.get(EmbeddingRunRecord, run.id)
            if (
                version.active_embedding_run_id != run.id
                or selected is None
                or selected.outcome != "complete"
                or selected.superseded
                or selected.quarantined
                or selected.project_id != self._project_id
                or selected.project_version_id != self._snapshot_id
                or selected.processing_run_id != self._authority.id
                or selected.processing_revision != self._authority.revision
                or selected.processing_contract != self._authority.processing_contract
                or selected.contract_digest != run.contract.digest
                or selected.dimensions != run.contract.dimensions
            ):
                raise EmbeddingConflictError("Search embedding authority changed.")

def __init__(self, settings: Settings) -> None:
        self.settings = settings
        self.engine = create_database_engine(settings)
        self.session_factory = create_session_factory_from_engine(self.engine)
        self.scan_lock = Lock()
        self.analysis_lock = Lock()
        self.processing_lock = Lock()
        self.embedding_runtime = EmbeddingRuntime(
            SupervisedSentenceTransformer(
                Path(settings.embeddings_cache_dir).expanduser(),
                revision=settings.embeddings_model_revision,
                model_load_timeout_seconds=settings.embeddings_model_load_timeout_seconds,
                batch_timeout_seconds=settings.embeddings_batch_timeout_seconds,
                window_batch_size=settings.embeddings_window_batch_size,
                max_rss_bytes=settings.embeddings_worker_max_rss_bytes,
            )
        )
        self.reranker_runtime = RerankerRuntime(
            SupervisedCrossEncoder(
                Path(settings.reranker_cache_dir).expanduser(),
                revision=settings.reranker_model_revision,
                model_load_timeout_seconds=settings.reranker_model_load_timeout_seconds,
                batch_timeout_seconds=settings.reranker_inference_timeout_seconds,
                batch_size=settings.reranker_batch_size,
                max_rss_bytes=settings.reranker_worker_max_rss_bytes,
            )
        )
        self.generation_provider = (
            GeminiProvider(
                settings.gemini_api_key.get_secret_value() if settings.gemini_api_key else None
            )
            if settings.generation_provider == "gemini"
            else OpenAIProvider(
                settings.openai_api_key.get_secret_value() if settings.openai_api_key else None
            )
        )

def _rank_hybrid(
        lexical_page: CandidatePage,
        semantic_page: CandidatePage,
        exact: dict[UUID, tuple[ExactMatch, ...]],
    ) -> list[_Ranked]:
        values: dict[UUID, _Ranked] = {}
        for rank, raw in enumerate(lexical_page.items, 1):
            lexical_item = cast(LexicalCandidate, raw)
            if lexical_item.chunk_id in values:
                continue
            values[lexical_item.chunk_id] = _Ranked(
                lexical_item.chunk_id,
                lexical_item.stable_key,
                exact.get(lexical_item.chunk_id, lexical_item.exact_matches),
                None,
                RankedComponent(rank, lexical_item.score, lexical_item.field_scores),
                None,
                Fraction(1, RRF_CONSTANT + rank),
            )
        seen_semantic: set[UUID] = set()
        for rank, raw in enumerate(semantic_page.items, 1):
            semantic_item = cast(SemanticCandidate, raw)
            if semantic_item.chunk_id in seen_semantic:
                continue
            seen_semantic.add(semantic_item.chunk_id)
            previous = values.get(semantic_item.chunk_id)
            contribution = Fraction(1, RRF_CONSTANT + rank)
            values[semantic_item.chunk_id] = _Ranked(
                semantic_item.chunk_id,
                semantic_item.stable_key,
                exact.get(semantic_item.chunk_id, ()),
                None,
                previous.lexical if previous else None,
                RankedComponent(rank, semantic_item.score, embedding=semantic_item.embedding),
                cast(Fraction, previous.score) + contribution if previous else contribution,
            )
        ordered_exact = sorted(
            (item for item in values.values() if item.exact_matches),
            key=lambda item: (item.stable_key, str(item.chunk_id)),
        )
        exact_ranks = {item.chunk_id: rank for rank, item in enumerate(ordered_exact, 1)}
        ranked = [
            _Ranked(
                item.chunk_id,
                item.stable_key,
                item.exact_matches,
                exact_ranks.get(item.chunk_id),
                item.lexical,
                item.semantic,
                item.score,
            )
            for item in values.values()
        ]
        return sorted(
            ranked,
            key=lambda item: (
                not bool(item.exact_matches),
                -cast(Fraction, item.score),
                item.stable_key,
                str(item.chunk_id),
            ),
        )
